title: Potential Reentrancy Vector via External Token Transfers in `GemJoin.join` and `GemJoin.exit`
impact: In `GemJoin.join`, state updates (`vat.slip`) occur *before* the external ERC-20 `transferFrom` execution. While MakerDAO relies on trusted collateral tokens, supporting ERC-777, ERC-1155, or tokens with transfer hooks opens up potential read-only reentrancy or state inconsistency across dependent CDP modules (`Vat`).
